title_zh: 美股大型银行与投行核心 KPI
title_en: US Large Banks & Investment Banks KPIs
sector_scope: US Commercial Banks & Large Broker-Dealer BHCs (SEC SIC 6020-6036, 6211)

kpis.name_zh: 净利息收入、净息差 (FTE)、PPNR 与成本收入比
kpis.definition_and_formula: PPNR = Net Rev - Nonint Exp; Efficiency = Nonint Exp / Net Rev (GAAP vs Managed/FTE); NIM = Annualized FTE NII / Avg Earning Assets
kpis.where_to_look: 8-K EX-99.1/2/3 Supplement, 10-Q Segment Details (R*.htm) & MD&A Avg Balance Sheet
red_flags: Negative operating leverage (expense outpacing net revenue)
Deposit beta outpacing asset yields, compressing NIM >= 15bps QoQ

kpis.name_en: CET1 Standardized Buffer & HTM Unrealized Loss
kpis.name_zh: CET1 资本缓冲与 HTM 浮亏压力
kpis.definition_and_formula: CET1 Buffer = (Std CET1 - Reg Min [4.5%+SCB+G-SIB]) * 100 bps; HTM Overhang = |HTM FV - Amortized Cost| / TCE; Pro-Forma CET1 ex-HTM (24% tax)
kpis.where_to_look: 10-Q Reg Capital (BHC parent ex-N.A. bank sub) & HTM Securities Details (R*.htm)
red_flags: CET1 Std buffer < 100bps above reg minimum (red < 50bps)
HTM pre-tax loss >= 30% of TCE stacked with thin CET1 buffer or deposit outflow

kpis.name_zh: 拨备占比、净核销率、不良率与拨备覆盖
kpis.definition_and_formula: Provision/PPNR = Provision / PPNR; Annualized NCO = Q NCO * 4 / Avg Loans; ACL/Loans = ACL / Gross Loans; NPL = Nonaccrual / Gross Loans
kpis.where_to_look: 8-K Credit Quality Supplement & 10-Q Allowance / Nonaccrual notes (R*.htm)
red_flags: Provision absorbs >= 30% of PPNR (red >= 50%) or reserve release masks rising NCOs
CRE/card delinquencies & nonaccruals rise while ACL/Loans declines

kpis.name_zh: ROTCE、双口径 TBVPS 与 Gordon 隐含回报
kpis.definition_and_formula: TBVPS Reported = Mgmt TCE / Basic Shares (incl. RSUs); XBRL-Std = (Eq - Pref - GW - Intang ex-MSR) / Ending Common; Implied ROTCE = g + (P/TBV)*(Ke - g)
kpis.where_to_look: 8-K Non-GAAP TCE/TBVPS/ROTCE tables & 10-Q MD&A Non-GAAP Measures
red_flags: Market P/TBV implies permanent ROTCE > 300bps above through-cycle ROTCE
Reported vs XBRL-Std TBVPS diverges > 1% via RSU denominators without bridge

filing_focus: 10-Q Segment Details (R*.htm): GAAP vs Managed/FTE & zero-delta revenue conservation
10-Q Reg Capital Details (BHC parent ex-N.A. bank sub) & HTM fair value vs amortized cost
8-K EX-99.1/2/3 Supplement & 10-Q MD&A Non-GAAP TBVPS/ROTCE reconciliation

counter_evidence_angles.angle: Buyback capacity constrained by thin CET1 buffer, RWA inflation, or HTM unrealized losses
counter_evidence_angles.evidence_anchor: 10-Q Reg Capital (CET1 Std vs 4.5%+SCB+G-SIB) & HTM FV vs amortized cost
counter_evidence_angles.next_quarter_trigger: Next-Q CET1 buffer < 100bps or buybacks pause/cut QoQ

counter_evidence_angles.angle: Normalized credit cost & deposit repricing pushing through-cycle ROTCE below Gordon implied ROTCE
counter_evidence_angles.evidence_anchor: Provision/PPNR, NCO vs reserve build, NIM FTE & bank_valuation_and_peer_compare spread
counter_evidence_angles.next_quarter_trigger: Next-Q NCO rate rises >= 15bps QoQ or ROTCE drops below implied ROTCE

unit_and_period_checks: Separate Consolidated GAAP vs Managed/FTE net revenue & PPNR explicitly
Normalize decimal ratios (0.115) vs percent strings (11.5%) in R*.htm Reg Capital
Use Reported TBVPS as primary P/TBV basis with XBRL-Std bridge
Use BHC consolidated CET1/SLR; exclude operating subsidiary (N.A.) capital blocks

reconciliation.note: verify OpSegs + Corp/Other + Reconciling = Consolidated GAAP (delta <= $2M)
bridge Goodwill, Intangibles ex-MSR & unconditional RSU shares

limits: Industrial EV/EBITDA, gross margin, DIO/CCC, standard FCF & Reverse-DCF stay disabled.
Insurance (SIC 6300-6411), REITs (6798) & pure asset managers remain outside this pack.
